title: A single mutation in bovine influenza H5N1 hemagglutinin switches specificity to human receptors | Science
content: In 2024, several human infections with highly pathogenic clade 2.3.4.4b bovine influenza H5N1 viruses in the United States raised concerns about their capability for bovine-to-human or even human-to-human transmission. In this study, analysis of the ...
